commands.help.advance: Review or buy the active character's next advancement with XP.
commands.advancement.no_character: Create or select a character before spending XP.
commands.advancement.unsupported: This character's rule system does not expose an advancement purchase flow.
commands.advancement.uninitialized: This character has no initialized XP budget. Starting XP is granted only by character creation.
commands.advancement.usage: Usage: .advance [<category> <target>] — for example `.advance characteristic Ag`, `.advance skill Acrobatics`, or `.advance talent Быстрая Перезарядка`.
commands.advancement.none: No further concrete purchases are available.
commands.advancement.invalid: That advancement cannot be bought now. Check the target, specialization, prerequisites, sequence, and remaining XP.
commands.advancement.save_failed: The advancement was not saved, so it is not treated as purchased.
commands.advancement.creation_hint: Starting advancement budget: {available} XP. Finish the remaining creation choices, then use `.advance` to review purchases.
